headlines.title: Death toll climbs to more than 600, with 2,400 still missing as rescue efforts continue
headlines.description: The death toll from catastrophic flash floods and mudslides in Nepal rose to at least 669 on Saturday, as more than 2,400 people remained missing in the country, including around 90 Americans.

headlines.title: President Trump announces 'biggest oil deal in world history'
headlines.description: President Trump says the U.S. has entered into a deal with Venezuela to take control of 65 billion barrels of oil "at no cost to the American taxpayer." Secretary Marco Rubio also claiming this deal a "huge win for both the American and Venezuelan people."

headlines.title: The unspoken testimony in the Lindsay Clancy trial
headlines.description: Dozens of witnesses were called over three weeks in the murder trial of Lindsay Clancy to testify about what led up to and followed the killing of her three young children. But one person who didn’t take the stand was Clancy herself. Both the prosecution and defense, however, read extensively from Clancy’s diary entries from the months leading up to the killings in a coastal Massachusetts town in 2023. Misty Marris breaks down what each side read from the diaries, and what they suggested her

headlines.title: NASA administrator explains how Roman Telescope will change understanding of the universe
headlines.description: NBC News' Gadi Schwartz speaks with NASA administrator Jared Isaacman about the Nancy Grace Roman Telescope launch, the Artemis III launch in 2027, and SpaceX's new Louisiana Starbase.

headlines.title: Meet the humanoid robots cleaning homes for $30 an hour
headlines.description: These $30-an-hour humanoid robots are cleaning homes in San Francisco, tackling tasks like mopping floors, tidying rooms and cleaning kitchens. NBC News' Tom Llamas speaks with Tau Robotics CEO and co-founder Alexander Koch about how the robots work and the challenges of making them fully A.I. powered.

headlines.title: NASA Set to Launch Next Generation Flagship Space Telescope
headlines.description: NASA is preparing for the weekend launch of the most advanced deep space telescope ever that will allow us to see thousands of planets, millions of galaxies and billions of stars. It’s designed to help us learn more about the universe and whether humans are alone. NBC’s Tom Costello reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Meta Vows Changes After $18B Settlement in Child Safety Case
headlines.description: Meta, the parent company of Facebook and Instagram, agreed to pay up to $18 billion in a closely watched social media addiction case brought by 29 states. Under the landmark settlement, the company says it will make major changes to its platforms to better protect kids and teens. NBC’s Christine Romans reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Father pushes for change after Meta's $18 billion settlement
headlines.description: Meta has agreed to an $18 billion settlement in a major child safety case tied to claims that social media platforms can harm young users. John Demay, whose son Jordan died after an online sextortion scheme, speaks with NBC News' Tom Llamas about his fight to make social media safer for children and families.

headlines.title: Meta agrees to pay $18 billion to settle social media addiction lawsuit
headlines.description: Meta has agreed to settle the social media addiction trial brought forward by California and other states for nearly $18 billion. NBC News' Allie Canal and Misty Marris have details on the settlement and what it means for the social media giant.

headlines.title: How to Get a Real Customer Service Person on the Phone
headlines.description: Navigating customer service isn’t always easy, so NBC’s Vicky Nguyen stops by TODAY to share how to get a real person on the phone, the best way to talk to chatbots, and tips for getting what you need.

headlines.title: Upgrade Your Wardrobe and Accessories for Fall with These Deals
headlines.description: Fall is right around the corner, and now is the perfect time to stock up on new fashion and accessories. TODAY lifestyle and commerce contributor Jill Martin stops by Studio 1A for the latest installment of Jill’s Steals & Deals. Get the best deals on jeans, totes, jewelry, and more!

headlines.title: SpaceX wants to turn Louisiana marshland into a Starship hub
headlines.description: SpaceX's Elon Musk plans to build new Starship launchpads in Louisiana, replacing sections of marshland as part of a major spaceport project. Space journalist Kristin Fisher talks with NBC News' Gadi Schwartz about the plans.
